headline: Sri Lanka central bank rejects claims account freezes stopped plantation payouts.
summary: Governor Nandalal Weerasinghe said claims that plantation firms cannot pay salaries or depositors due to central bank account freezes are false. He said only a small portion of illegally collected deposits was frozen.
why: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka regulates the country's banking system and monetary policy. Its actions on deposit-taking and account freezes affect depositors, lenders and the broader financial sector.
